subject: Connector bundle SKU & certification questions for co-sell listing
messages:
From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@edgeforge.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: partnerships@edgeforge.com
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Interest in marketplace co-sell + bundling questions

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the intro call last week — really excited about a potential co-sell listing for EdgeForge + Redwood. We started building a draft SKU mapping for the connector bundle and have a few questions before we finalize the submission: 

- For combined bundles (EdgeForge connector + Redwood inference credits), do you require separate SKU IDs for the listing or a single bundled SKU?
- Certification evidence: what level of technical artifacts are mandatory for a co-sell badge on AWS/GCP? (We have a basic integration test suite, but not a formal cert pack.)
- Timeline: we're aiming to submit the listing in Q4 — are there common gating items that typically delay approval?

I attached the draft SKU map and a short product summary for context. Could you point us to the right checklist and whether anyone at Redwood can help validate the evidence before we file?

Appreciate it — happy to hop on a quick review call.

Best,
Sarah Lee
Partnerships Lead, EdgeForge Systems
[Attachment: edgeforge-sku-map.xlsx (xlsx, 12KB)]
[Attachment: product-summary.pdf (pdf, 45KB)]

From: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@edgeforge.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interest in marketplace co-sell + bundling questions

Hi Sarah — thanks for the doc and the clear questions. Looping in Ben (sales) and Karthik (alliances) so we can give a consolidated answer and help triage the evidence. Quick answers up front: 

- Bundles vs separate SKUs: We support both patterns. Bundled SKUs speed up listing UX but require a clear entitlement mapping in the catalog. If you want resale/marketplace billing, we usually recommend a bundled SKU plus line-item metadata that ties back to EdgeForge entitlement.
- Certification evidence: minimum is a technical integration runbook, a connectivity test plan, and a telemetry/usage sample proving calls to Redwood inference endpoints. For AWS/GCP co-sell badges there are additional platform-specific docs (we can share templates).
- Common gating items: missing metering proofs (sample invoice or telemetry showing usage), incomplete entitlement mapping, and legal contract mismatches for joint offers.

Ben/Karthik — can one of you take point on the SKU entitlements and co-sell evidence checklist? Sarah, if you can highlight which of the items in the attached map are mandatory vs optional for your business, that will help our prioritization.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Sr. Partner Engineer, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
[Attachment referenced: edgeforge-sku-map.xlsx]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@edgeforge.com>, olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2027 08:31:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interest in marketplace co-sell + bundling questions

Hi Sarah — quick commercial note from our side: we prefer a single bundled SKU for co-sell so customers see a single line item in the marketplace checkout. Operational asks: 

- We need a simple rev-share / revenue allocation note for the bundled SKU (high level is fine — we can formalize later).
- Procurement: will EdgeForge support marketplace private offers or do you need Redwood to own the private offer flow?

I attached a very small SKU mapping template we've used (minimal columns: sku_id, sku_name, entitlements, billing_owner). Once you confirm who owns procurement and the rough rev-share split, I can draft the marketplace submission and loop in our legal ops.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-bundle-sku-template.csv (csv, 3KB)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@edgeforge.com>, ben.carter@redwood.ai, olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 5 Nov 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interest in marketplace co-sell + bundling questions

Sarah — thanks for moving quickly on this. Proposed next steps and timeline: 

1) Today — Redwood reviews your draft SKU map and flags missing entitlements (Olga will validate technical mapping).
2) By Nov 10 — EdgeForge provides: (a) final sku map, (b) sample telemetry or demo account for metering proof, (c) brief legal contact for private offer coordination.
3) Nov 11–17 — Redwood prepares evidence bundle and the marketplace submission (we will use bundled SKU pattern unless you request otherwise).
4) Nov 18–Dec 2 — Platform review window (depends on AWS/GCP cycles); we’ll flag blockers earlier if they appear.

Links: 
- Internal runbook: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/GTMP-1234
- Shared folder (please upload telemetry): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-edgeforge-co-sell

Let us know if that timeline works. If so, Ben and I will prepare a one-pager for your procurement team and I’ll assign a small checklist for our technical QA run.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Alliances & GTM, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: co-sell-evidence-checklist.pdf (pdf, 98KB)]
